description: This file defines a React component for displaying a grid of recommendation role cards based on user persona data. It includes functions for URL joining, skill chip styling, normalization, skill extraction, and computing skill mastery/growth sets. The main exported component, 'RecommendationGrid', fetches recommendation data from an API endpoint and renders individual role cards ('RoleCardHiFi') with detailed role info and skill tags.

classes.name: RoleCardHiFi
classes.description: A React component that renders detailed information about a recommended role, including title, industry, salary, experience, description, responsibilities, and required skills with proficiency-based tags.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Concatenates a base URL with a path, ensuring proper slash handling.

methods.name: skillChipStyle
methods.description: Returns styling objects for skill tags based on proficiency category ('mastery', 'growth', or 'neutral').

methods.name: normalizeSkill
methods.description: Trims and converts a skill string to lowercase for standardization.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkillsWithProficiency
methods.description: Extracts an array of skills with proficiency levels from various possible attributes within the person's data object.

methods.name: computeMasteryGrowthSets
methods.description: Determines sets of skill names categorized as 'mastery' (>=80%) or 'growth' (20–60%) based on proficiency values.
